# Implementation Plan: Card Game Hardening & GG-Only Launch Mode

**Branch**: `004-card-game-hardening` | **Date**: 2026-06-25 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/004-card-game-hardening/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by `/speckit-plan`. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the execution workflow.

## Summary

Hardens the card game for a Girl-Group-only launch by adding (1) a config-driven `gg_only_mode` flag enforced by a `403` guard on every Boy-Group-scoped route, (2) tightened input validation on the remaining write paths, (3) an idempotent annual Ultra-Rare ticket grant driven by operator-configured calendar dates and run from the existing daily scheduler, and (4) a frontend that reads the flag and hides Boy-Group entry points (defense in depth). Most write validation and lineup card-ownership checks already exist in `backend/routes/cardGame.js`; this feature closes the remaining gaps, formalizes the gating boundary, and runs the full Feature 001 quickstart (Scenarios 1–10) as the regression gate. No new npm packages; two new additive DB tables for the grant feature.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Node.js 20 (backend), React 18 + Vite (frontend)

**Primary Dependencies**: express 5, pg, node-cron, React — no new packages required

**Storage**: PostgreSQL via `pg` pool; schema changes additive only (two new tables: `ur_grant_dates`, `ur_grant_log`). The `gg_only_mode` flag reuses the existing `gacha_config` key/value table.

**Testing**: No automated test framework. Validation via this feature's `quickstart.md` plus the Feature 001 quickstart Scenarios 1–10 (manual acceptance pass).

**Target Platform**: Linux server (Express REST API) + browser (React SPA)

**Project Type**: Web application (Express REST API + React SPA)

**Performance Goals**: No latency targets. The annual grant is a once-per-day cron writing one column for all users (small player base); the 403 guard adds a single in-memory config read per gated request.

**Constraints**: No new npm dependencies. All schema changes additive (no drops, no renames). Seed/migration scripts idempotent. The backend 403 guard is the authoritative trust boundary; frontend hiding is UX-only and must never be relied on for security. Validation failures must return actionable errors and leave player state unchanged.

**Scale/Scope**: Small player base (test/launch phase). Grant touches all `users` rows in one `UPDATE`; no performance concern.
